_comment: What Scadu League's colours MEAN, for the board's key. Same job and same keying as
rookieRumbleColorNames.json - read that one first, its notes cover both.
Four of nine are named. The other five are deliberately left empty, and that is the honest
answer rather than a gap to be filled in later by guesswork: Rookie Rumble's palette is plainly
regional and says so in its own square names, and this one ISN'T. Romina is orange and 'Drain
the Water in the Church District' is yellow, and those are the same building - so any label
reading 'Shadow Keep' on either group would be telling a team something untrue about where a
square sends them, which is the one thing a colour key must never do.
An empty string falls back to listing the group's own keywords, so an unnamed colour still
answers 'why is this square red' - just with examples instead of a name. Fill one in the moment
you know what the author meant by it; nothing else has to change.
128, 128, 255  every square is the Cerulean Coast or the Finger Ruins fissure
128, 255, 255  Rellana, Moonrithyll, the Divine Bird, Dryleaf Dane - Ensis and the road to it
Red            Bayle, Senessax, Florissax, Igon, Dragon Communion - the dragon run
